Ana (product): quick sync: competitor rolled out a price-focused "lite" search product. we need a plan that balances parity vs protecting our differentiators.
Sam (PM): can we outline 2 concrete experiments: one "parity" quick ship, one "differentiate" longer-term? what are launch gates for each?
Dee (eng): implementation note: parity path (adapter routing + param map) is ~1 week with 2 engs. parity with compressed embeddings + quantized runtime is a 6-week effort with infra validation.
Kunal (sales): we have 3 inbound customers asking specifically for 40-60% unit cost reduction. they will accept lower quality if we quantify it and keep an SLA. need something demoable fast.
Priya (solutions): sample parity adapter behavior: route requests when tenant flag set, translate batch_size and truncation, and optionally forward to partner endpoint. pseudo-config: ```- name: price_mode route: partner_x when: tenant in alpha_pilots transform: truncate: 1024 compress_embeddings: true```
Iris (data): success metrics for pilot: per-request cost, quality delta (ROC-AUC on rerank set), error rate, and customer satisfaction NPS. baseline cost = $0.008/token; target pilot cost = $0.0038/token.
Olga (design): UX ask: in Console show "Cost mode" with inline comparison: expected cost delta, expected quality risk (small/big), and a per-route toggle with confirmation modals. small mock ready.
Sam (PM): Experiment definitions: EXP-A (parity adapter): deliver adapter + console toggle + pilot run for 2 customers. Gate: achieve >=35% cost reduction and quality drop <=15% on eval set, no SLA incidents. EXP-B (quantized tier): run spike + internal eval; gate: if quantized can achieve >=50% cost reduction with acceptable quality within 3 sprints, consider product tier.
Dee (eng): risks for adapter: increased latency if partner is remote; need fallback. added constraint: adapters must preserve API semantics (headers, streaming) or it's a dealbreaker.
Priya (solutions): note on compliance: some customers require no external routing. for those, parity adapter won't work; quantized local tier is the only path. mark these tenants in pilot exclusion list.
Iris (data): set up dashboards: per-tenant cost, 7d rolling quality score, latency p95, and error-rate. will add alert when quality delta >20% or error rate >1%.
Kunal (sales): I'll surface tradeoff doc to pilot customers. need pricing language: "beta price tier: -50% unit cost, initial SLA: best-effort with 24h response". please advise if conservative.
Olga (design): console copy suggestion: "Beta cost-tier: lowers compute cost but may alter result relevance. Use per-route toggle to opt-in."
deploy-bot: rollout queued for branch `parity-adapter-beta` to canary group at 03:45 UTC :rocket:
Sam (PM): Owners & schedule: Dee -> adapter PRD + spike (due Thu), Priya -> partner integration checklist (due Fri), Iris -> dashboards (by Tue), Olga -> console copy + mock (by Tue), Kunal -> pilot commitments (EOW).
Ana (product): decision logic: if EXP-A meets gate after 2-week pilot we turn into a paid beta; if not, we deprecate adapter and prioritize quantized tier spike. keep communication to pilots transparent about quality tradeoffs.
Kunal (sales): pinging acme/zenit/fastco for opt-ins now. will report back with 2 firm pilots by Wed.
Dee (eng): starting spike now, will post notes in the PR and @channel any infra blockers.
Ana (product): great. small ask: capture a short customer-facing FAQ for pilots (quality expectations, data routing, opt-out). Priya can you draft?
Priya (solutions): yes, will draft FAQ and partner terms draft today.
Ana (product): thanks all. follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
